general.title: I built a self-hosted app to see all my Steam, PlayStation and Xbox games in one place
general.describe: I play on PC, PS5 and Xbox, plus a Switch that sits next to the TV. Every platform has its own library, its own stats and its own idea of what "played" means. I wanted one page where I could see everything: what I own, what I actually played, and the pile of games I keep buying and never start. The existing tools didn't fit what I wanted. Some are desktop-only, some are hosted services where my data lives on someone else's server. I run a small homelab anyway, so I built Playroom , a self-hosted web app for your whole game collection.
